## Added

- **`readyset-flow update`** — alias for `install`. Refresh the linked extension and skill docs
  without remembering `install`'s exact name.
- **`readyset-flow uninstall [--target <path>] [--keep-config]`** — reverses everything `install`
  sets up:
  - Removes the extension entry from `~/.omp/agent/settings.json` (matched by basename, so it
    works regardless of which copy of the package wrote it).
  - Deletes the installed skill docs from the target project.
  - Strips the readyset-managed block out of `~/.omp/agent/config.yml`, reusing the same splice
    logic as `configure`. Pass `--keep-config` to leave `config.yml` untouched.
  - Does **not** touch project-level `readyset/changes/` directories — your review history stays.

## Install / Update / Uninstall

```
npx readyset-flow install
npx readyset-flow update
npx readyset-flow uninstall
```
or with `bunx` in place of `npx`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/fresp/readyset-flow/compare/0.10.0...0.11.0
